blocks.label: Re-anchor
blocks.text: Following up on my note from last week, no worries if the timing is off.

blocks.label: New angle
blocks.guidance: Since there is no advertised role, add ONE new, concrete piece of value that lowers the bar to a conversation: a specific observation about what they are building or a small, tangible way the candidate could help, tied to one piece of evidence. Keep it exploratory and low-pressure, one or two short sentences. Do not repeat the first email or use filler openers.

blocks.label: Single ask
blocks.text: Even 15 minutes would be useful, but no pressure if it is not the right time.

style.notes: A speculative follow-up has no role to anchor to, so it must earn the reply on curiosity and a concrete, low-cost offer. Warm, brief, genuinely easy to decline. One new specific hook, one gentle ask.
